caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects positioned side by side against a plain, off-white background. Both objects are predominantly brown, with variations in shading that indicate wood grain and carved decorative patterns. The object on the left is more ornate, featuring a rounded hollow center, a jagged inner edge, carved leafy and zig-zag patterns on its outer surface, and a stepped or grooved extended top section. The object on the right is similar in shape but simpler, with a rounded, almost triangular hollow center and a less decorative surface. It has a pair of light-colored vertical stripes at the top, and a small horizontal bar across the opening near the top. Each object exhibits clear wood texture, suggesting they are made from solid wood, and both rest on a neutral background with the artist's name "R.W.B. Taylor" written in the lower right corner.
title: Stirrup
